question: Can the sound of the Veda confer blessings while it is being performed?
premises: The Vedic sound is being performed
The particle eva emphasizes its ongoing state
A wish is expressed that it may make blessings
inference: The very performance of the Vedic sound is invoked to produce blessings.
plain_english: May the sound of the Veda, even as it is being performed, bring blessings.
